name: Mimiri Notes
blurb: A secure, open-source notepad for your confidential notes, credentials, and sensitive data with end-to-end encryption and real-time synchronization across all your devices.
description:
A secure, open-source notepad for your confidential notes, credentials, and sensitive data with end-to-end encryption and real-time synchronization across all your devices.

Key features:

• End-to-end encryption with AES-GCM-256 to protect your data before it leaves your device

• Real-time synchronization across all platforms

• Hierarchical organization with unlimited nesting of notes

• Collaborative sharing of encrypted notes with trusted contacts

• Complete version history to track and restore previous versions

• Offline access with local encrypted cache

• Password masking for sensitive text

• No tracking - your data stays private

All data is encrypted client-side before transmission. The open-source codebase (GPLv2) ensures transparent security with features like automatic locking, secure password fields, and a recycle bin for accidental deletions.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
